name: Processing Status 82 Choice
definition: Provides the status of an instruction.

Processed.name: Processed
Processed.definition: Transaction or instruction has been processed.

Future.name: Future
Future.definition: All checks relative to the instruction (except collateral) are successful.

Rejected.name: Rejected
Rejected.definition: Instruction has been rejected for further processing.

PendingCancellation.name: Pending Cancellation
PendingCancellation.definition: Cancellation request is pending on the instruction.

CancellationRequest.name: Cancellation Request
CancellationRequest.definition: A cancellation request from your counterparty for this transaction is pending waiting for your cancellation request.
